name: VentureOne Business

apr.notes: 16.74% - 22.74% variable APR based on your creditworthiness.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. Pay zero foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 1.5X miles on every purchase for your business.

categories.label: 5X miles on hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Business Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem miles through travel site, get reimbursed for travel expenses, or transfer miles to 15+ partners. Can also redeem for cash, gift cards or Amazon account.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a one-time bonus of 50,000 miles once you spend $4,500 on purchases within the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Pay zero foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

benefits.title: Hertz Five Star Status
benefits.description: Skip the counter at select locations, enjoy a wider selection of rental cars and more, just for being a VentureOne Business cardholder.

benefits.title: Rental collision insurance
benefits.description: With your VentureOne Business card, you're covered for any damage or theft that may happen when you rent an eligible car.

benefits.title: Roadside assistance
benefits.description: Our business cards offer services to help you during auto-related emergencies, such as jump-starting, tire changing and towing.

benefits.title: $0 fraud liability
benefits.description: If your card is lost or stolen, you can get an emergency replacement and a cash advance.

benefits.title: Free employee cards
benefits.description: Track employee spending while earning all the rewards from their purchases.

benefits.title: Virtual cards
benefits.description: Make safer payments online without exposing your actual card number with merchants.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.description: Get free additional warranty and protection on eligible items you purchase with your card.

benefits.title: Capital One Business Travel
benefits.description: Save time and money with complimentary access to an all-in-one business travel management solution.

benefits.title: Accounts Payable
benefits.description: Manage your accounts payable process by sending and tracking payments all in one place.

notes: Verified against the official Capital One product page on 2026-07-25. Earns unlimited 1.5X miles on every purchase plus 5X miles on hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Business Travel. Business (small-business) card; segment set to 'business'.
